meta.title: Block n’ Roll — Beach volleyball club in Barcelona

hero.headline: Beach volleyball
hero.intro: Train on the sand courts at CEM Vall d’Hebron in small groups, with sessions tailored to your level.
hero.caption: Block n’ Roll on court
hero.photoAlt: A coach demonstrates a receiving stance to a group of players on a sand court

training.title: Train at your pace
training.intro: We train in groups of up to 8, with 90-minute sessions for adults and juniors of all levels.

one_per_week.title: One session a week
one_per_week.description: A weekly session to get started or keep playing regularly.

two_per_week.title: Two sessions a week
two_per_week.description: More court time to build on what you learn in each session.

private.title: Private training
private.description: A session built around your goals, scheduled with the coaching team.

training.schedule: Monday to Thursday, 18:00 to 22:30, in three time slots.
training.license: Required to train at Vall d’Hebron. It includes sports insurance and costs around {{amount}} a year. The club can arrange it at no extra charge.
training.licenseWithoutPrice: Required to train at Vall d’Hebron. It includes sports insurance and the club can arrange it.
training.priceNote: Rates are for groups of 8. Groups with a high-level coach may cost an extra {{supplement}} per month. Card payments via Cluber carry a processing fee of around {{fee}}% plus VAT.
training.trialTerms: The trial is free and comes with no commitment. If you join, the trial session is included in the prorated monthly fee.

club.title: It started on the court
club.story: We’re Sara, Jesús and David. After years of training and competing, we started Block n’ Roll to share beach volleyball and bring together people who want to play.
club.approach: On court we work on technique and gameplay at your pace, from your first touches to competition.
club.credentials: Jesús and David hold official Level 1 beach volleyball certification and have over six years of training and competition experience.

imageDescriptions.training: 2026–27 season training poster showing a receiving demonstration on the sand
imageDescriptions.schedule: Monday-to-Thursday timetable with three time slots for women’s, men’s and mixed groups
imageDescriptions.competition: The club’s five teams in the Catalan First Division and National Second Division, in the women’s and men’s categories
imageDescriptions.join: Club poster inviting players to join training
